author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I will write a repsonse and capture quotes throughout the week but part of my digital minimalism is to enjoy books made from paper. I also think better on paper so ebverything I do begins there

Yet for twenty years I fill up random notebooks, moleskins, and scraps of paper with thoughts and lose them forever. Been trying to use Ian O'Byrne's idea of the common place book but never found my nitch. I stunk at Evernote, Google Keep failed, the only minimalist approach I could maximze is my own website.

If you would like to add my book club to your feed reader I will tag everything #digitalminimalism and the relevant #chapter1. You can add that to any RSS, microformats, or JSON feed reader of choice. Then we could add a Slack bot if we want
